Based on the 2011 Census of India data, the second fastest growing language after Hindi was English. The growth rates were: Hindi (fastest), English (second fastest), Meitei/Manipuri (third), and Bengali (fourth).

This reflects the significant increase in English speakers in India during the 2001-2011 period, primarily due to its importance in education, business, and as a lingua franca across the country.
